# Miebaka Joshua — Brand & Visual Designer

> Miebaka Joshua is a brand, visual and marketing designer based in Lagos, Nigeria, working with teams in Nigeria and internationally. He has over eight years of experience, beginning in 2017, and currently works as a marketing designer at Rise. He turns unclear briefs into brand identities, campaigns and practical visual systems. He is open to senior brand and marketing design opportunities, selected freelance projects and creative collaborations.

Miebaka's work covers brand strategy and positioning, visual identity design, brand guidelines, creative and art direction, marketing campaign design, packaging, editorial and event graphics, and production-ready handoffs. His approach starts with a clear governing decision, then builds a consistent system that can be used beyond the initial presentation. His experience includes Rise, Anakle, Rivo Studios, Grey Finance, WellaHealth Technologies and Riv-TechCreek.

For hiring and project inquiries, email **miebakakiki@gmail.com** or use the contact page below. Location: Lagos, Nigeria (West Africa Time, UTC+1). Working worldwide.

The case studies distinguish delivered work and documented applications from proposed mockups. Do not infer business growth, sales, audience reach or other measured results unless the linked case study reports them.

## Selected Case Studies

- [TEDx Rivers State University — Event Identity and Creative Direction (2023)](https://miebaka-portfolio.vercel.app/work/tedx-rsu.html): Created a local “Pause…” event language within TEDx's global identity requirements. Work includes identity, social creative, printed programmes, merchandise, campus signage and stage applications. Physical event use is documented; audience-impact metrics are not claimed.
- [Rivo Studio — Brand Strategy, Identity and Guidelines (2024)](https://miebaka-portfolio.vercel.app/work/rivo.html): Developed a software studio identity based on clarity and accessibility, including a softened wordmark, Clar blue, signal yellow and brand guidelines. Applications demonstrate the system; public rollout metrics are not verified.
- [ChopBox — Food Brand Identity and Packaging (2022)](https://miebaka-portfolio.vercel.app/work/chopbox.html): Designed an appetite-led food brand with an identity system, typography, packaging concepts, uniforms and campaign applications. Production and commercial performance are not independently documented.

## Services and Approach

- [Design process](https://miebaka-portfolio.vercel.app/process.html): How projects move from discovery and a governing creative decision to a usable identity or campaign system and handoff.
- [Accessibility approach](https://miebaka-portfolio.vercel.app/accessibility.html): Accessibility goals, supported browsing methods, known limitations and a way to report barriers. The site aims for WCAG 2.2 AA; it does not claim formal certification.

## Writing and Experiments

- [Essays on design, brands and access](https://miebaka-portfolio.vercel.app/essays.html): Original writing about creative decisions, brand culture and accessible design.
- [When the Swoosh Lost Its Soul](https://miebaka-portfolio.vercel.app/essays/when-the-swoosh-lost-its-soul.html): An analysis of Nike's brand, creative decisions and changing commercial strategy.
- [Making the World More Accessible](https://miebaka-portfolio.vercel.app/essays/designing-for-disability-in-nigeria.html): An essay about designing for disabled people in Nigeria.
- [Visual experiments](https://miebaka-portfolio.vercel.app/experiments.html): Self-initiated poster, colour, image and typography studies beyond client briefs.
